# vextis docs

> Secure app config for local development and CI — organizations, apps, environments, and encrypted parameters, managed from a CLI.

## Getting started
- [Overview](https://docs.vextis.io/docs): What vextis is and where to start.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/quickstart): Get a local app running with managed config.
- [About vextis](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/about): What vextis is for and who it is built for.

## Core concepts
- [Organizations](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/organizations): The root of every app, environment, and member.
- [Apps](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/apps): Deployable services and projects.
- [Environments](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/environments): Runtime targets like development and production.
- [Parameters](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/parameters): Encrypted config keys and values.
- [Inheritance](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/inheritance): Fallback behavior for unset values.
- [Authentication](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/authentication): JWT sessions, personal tokens, and service tokens.
- [Tokens](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/access-tokens): Personal and organization automation tokens.
- [Secrets & visibility](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/secrets-visibility): Secret-by-default values, reveal scopes, and protected environments.
- [Roles](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/roles-permissions): System roles and the scope model behind them.

## CLI
- [Install CLI](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/install-cli): Install and update the vextis CLI.
- [CLI login](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/cli-login): Authorize your terminal session.
- [CLI reference](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/cli-reference): The full command surface.
- [Config commands](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/config-commands): Pull, get, and set resolved config.
- [Linking a project](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/linking-a-project): Bind a working tree to an app and environment.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/troubleshooting): Common setup and permission issues.

## Automate
- [Run with env](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/run-with-env): Inject config into a child process.
- [CI/CD](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/ci-cd): Use VEXTIS_TOKEN in automation.

## Security & governance
- [Security model](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/security-model): Encryption, authorization, and audit posture.
- [Audit logs](https://docs.vextis.io/docs/audit-logs): Events recorded for sensitive actions.
